facts.fact: 阿拉里克被挤出了自己的舱房，白天拿鸡毛蒜皮的小事折腾船员，在自己船上四处游荡。
facts.anchor: driven from his own stateroom, spending the day terrorizing his crew

facts.fact: 塔拉辛在城塞见过他受父亲惩罚后流血破碎的样子，两次都给过他安慰和喘息。
facts.anchor: She had found him broken and bleeding from his father’s punishment

facts.fact: 晚饭开在军官食堂，妻子一在场，塞夫雷姆的话就多得收不住。
facts.anchor: his wife’s presence inspired Sevraim to even greater heights of loquacity

facts.fact: 伊莱丝当众指出塔拉辛在小屋遇袭时没有动用以太术。
facts.anchor: “You didn’t aethermance in the lodge,” Ileis pointed out.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛背过手碰了碰最上面那颗扣子，把求他解衣的意思摆明。
facts.anchor: touching the topmost button to make her meaning clear

facts.fact: 阿拉里克替她解扣时发现她左肩的雀斑像一团星簇，像那口锅。
facts.anchor: I never realized until now that it looks like a star cluster

facts.fact: 他把悲伤说成爱还留着的证据，说噬世者的爱强到能毁掉岛屿。
facts.anchor: Grief is proof that love remains.

facts.fact: 最后他一步步退开，把她一个人留在原地发冷。
facts.anchor: Then he was stepping back. Stepping away from her.
